title: Release feeds: Godot, Blender, 3D assets, 2D and animation tools
description: Official GitHub release, tag and commit Atom feeds for Godot and popular Godot add-ons, Blender and asset-pipeline tools, 2D/pixel/animation editors and physics engines. Each feed was fetched on 2026-10-10.

items.title: Godot Engine releases
items.summary: Stable and maintenance releases of Godot (3.x and 4.x branches share the feed).
items.notes: Atom releases feed fetched 2026-10-10; newest entry: 3.6.3-stable and 4.7.2-stable at the top on 2026-10-10.
cautions: GitHub serves these feeds without authentication but rate-limits by IP; poll at most hourly and send If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since.
